question: Close roborev-threshold-catches-pr-findings-poc with its result, no threshold change? FO recommends closing; approving accepts that recommendation: the bar (local catches on two of three heads) is not met, 1 of 5 Codex PR findings caught (#698 fragment, at medium and low), so .roborev.toml and roborev_gate.py stay unchanged.

artifacts.summary: Validation PASSED (AC-1, AC-2 met as written); the bar is not met. The gate ran at high because .roborev.toml sets review_min_severity = "high" at all three heads; roborev v0.62.0 default is no filter and SEVERITY_THRESHOLD_MET means every finding was below the active threshold. Medium and low runs: #694 0 of 1, #698 1 of 2, #693 0 of 2 (the P1 missed even at low). For #694 and #693 the cause is not the threshold. Open: F2 an unchecked extra local finding on #694; F4 one head where high hid a finding medium showed, Material if a second head repeats it.
